title: Remote sign-in client and the written protocol
description: Owner: Cyclotron session. remote.py: makes V and P, calls /start, prints the URL and matching code, polls at the interval and backs off on slow_down, exchanges the code with V, verifies issuer, client, token_use, expiry and nonce. docs/protocol.md for clients in other languages, and conformance features any client or broker can run.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in AnthusAI/cli-login#2 (2026-10-30), CI green on Linux, macOS and Windows x Python 3.10 and 3.13; security review by the Papyrus session addressed in the same PR. Not deployed: each product's broker deploy needs Ryan's approval. Follow-ups on this board: real-browser check, global ceiling/WAF, Target.remote_callback_uri (#3).
